items.stem: Which TWO features let Redshift work with data beyond its local storage? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Redshift Spectrum to query data in S3
options.rationale: Correct: Spectrum queries external S3 data.

options.text: Data sharing to access another cluster's data
options.rationale: Correct: data sharing exposes datasets across clusters.

options.text: Deleting the cluster to free data
options.rationale: Deleting a cluster removes access, not a way to use data.
Compression settings do not access external data.
